description:
INVITING OFFERS BETWEEN £110,000- £120,000
What We Love
“Superb one bed apartment! A share of freehold and no ground rent really help this property stand out from many apartments. Add the marina location and no onward chain, and there is plenty here to appeal to buyers.”
The Rest Of The Story
Egremont Russet is a second-floor, one-bedroom property in the marina area, just moments from Humber Street and the foreshore. Offered with vacant possession and no onward chain, it also comes with a share of the freehold and no ground rent.
The accommodation begins with an entrance hallway, with a shower room to the left comprising a WC, basin and shower cubicle.
Further inside is the open-plan living and dining area, with the kitchen positioned in one corner. The kitchen includes a range of wall and base units with space for the essential appliances, while the main living area provides room for both seating and dining furniture.
The bedroom is positioned at the front of the property and offers space for bedroom furniture, along with a large storage cupboard.
With its central marina position, share of freehold arrangement and no onward chain, this is a straightforward one-bedroom property that could suit buyers looking for a home close to Humber Street and the waterfront.
